name: The Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies 🍪
description: These are the ultimate homemade chocolate chip cookies: crispy golden edges, soft and chewy centres, buttery flavour and loads of melted chocolate. Perfect with a glass of milk!
method: 1. Prepare the oven
- Preheat your oven to 180°C (160°C fan).
- Line two baking trays with baking paper.
2. Cream the butter and sugars
- Place the softened butter, brown sugar and caster sugar into a large mixing bowl.
- Beat together for 2–3 minutes until creamy and fluffy.
3. Add the eggs and vanilla
- Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
- Stir in the vanilla extract.
4. Mix the dry ingredients
- In another bowl, combine the flour, bicarbonate of soda and salt.
- Gradually add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture.
- Mix until a soft cookie dough forms.
5. Add the chocolate
- Fold in the chocolate chips or chunks.
- Save a small handful to press into the tops of the cookies.
6. Shape the cookies
- Roll the dough into balls, roughly 2 tablespoons per cookie.
- Place onto the prepared baking trays, leaving plenty of space between each one.
- Press a few extra chocolate chunks into the tops.
7. Bake
- Bake for 10–12 minutes until the edges are lightly golden but the centres still look slightly soft.
- Don't worry if they look a little underdone in the middle.
8. Cool and enjoy
- Leave the cookies on the baking tray for 10 minutes.
- Transfer to a cooling rack to finish cooling.
My secret tips for perfect cookies
- Chill the dough for 30 minutes before baking for thicker cookies.
- Use a mixture of milk and dark chocolate chunks.
- Sprinkle a little sea salt on top before baking.
- Don't overbake them – that's the secret to a chewy middle!

name: Creamy Chicken Bacon Alfredo
description: A cosy, creamy pasta dish with chicken, bacon and plenty of cheese.
ingredients: 8 ounces freshly shredded Monterey Jack cheese
method: Step 1 – Preheat the oven
Preheat your oven to 180°C (160°C fan) / 350°F. Lightly grease a medium-sized ovenproof baking dish with butter or cooking spray.
Step 2 – Prepare the noodles
Cook the noodles according to the packet instructions. Drain well and set aside. Avoid overcooking them as they will continue cooking in the oven.
Step 3 – Prepare the creamy sauce
In a large mixing bowl, add the jar of Alfredo sauce and cream cheese. Stir together until combined. If the cream cheese is very firm, soften it slightly in the microwave first.
Step 4 – Add the seasoning
Add the half packet of ranch seasoning, a little salt, pepper and onion powder. Mix thoroughly to distribute the seasoning evenly.
Step 5 – Add the chicken and bacon
Add the shredded rotisserie chicken and chopped cooked bacon to the sauce mixture. Stir until the chicken and bacon are evenly coated.
Step 6 – Add the cheese and noodles
Add the 8 ounces of shredded Monterey Jack cheese and cooked noodles. Mix everything together until the noodles are completely covered in the creamy Alfredo mixture.
Step 7 – Assemble the bake
Pour the mixture into your prepared baking dish and spread it out evenly. Sprinkle the 2 ounces of mild cheddar cheese over the top.
Step 8 – Bake
Place the dish in the preheated oven and bake uncovered for 25–30 minutes, or until the cheese has melted, the edges are bubbling and the centre is piping hot (at least 74°C).
Step 9 – Rest and serve
Remove from the oven and allow it to stand for approximately 5 minutes before serving. This helps the sauce settle and makes it easier to serve.
